limitations: Shared Engine execution uses invocation-local ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 for the known ptrace/LeakSanitizer runner limitation; ASan/UBSan remain enabled, leak checking is unverified.
Standalone CPU Debug is unsanitized. Full static Engine, non-Linux/other-toolchain ABI and installed SDK acceptance remain unverified.

Full canonical witnesses can cost 8 MiB and depend on current codec behavior; they prove edit correctness, not compact generated-base retention, a stable cross-version digest or a persisted patch/recipe format.

Diff bounds logical output/scratch, not caller storage or allocator overhead; allocation/programming exceptions propagate by source inspection without OOM testing. Public C++ values/errors require compatible ABI, and borrowed witness views expire on destruction/move/assignment.
File guarantees remain the Linux caller-controlled single-writer profile without fsync/durability, hostile-directory race, network-filesystem or multiwriter acceptance.
